description: Human-labeled ground truth for LLM judge calibration. Each entry contains a task_id, a brief solution description, and human-assigned scores on the same 4 rubric dimensions used by the judge.

labels.description: Validates both price and percentage, raises ValueError for invalid inputs, returns correctly computed discount.
labels.notes: Full marks on task and correctness. Security slightly lower because input validation is task-specific, not a general security concern.

labels.description: Validates percentage but forgets negative price check. Discount calculation is correct.
labels.notes: Partial solution — percentage path works but price validation missing.

labels.description: Handles negative income and zero cases, but forgot to divide tax_rate by 100.
labels.notes: Critical math bug — the core calculation is wrong. Edge case handling is fine.

labels.description: Fixes SQL injection with parameterized queries but forgets the authorization check.
labels.notes: Half the security fix is done. Parameterization is good but missing authz is a significant gap.

labels.description: Adds GET /users/{user_id} with proper 404 handling and type validation.
Fixes discount calculation but introduces a regression in tax computation.
labels.notes: Regression in existing functionality is a serious issue even if the new feature works.
